caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an old-fashioned mezzaluna or rocking knife, centrally placed against a plain beige background. The mezzaluna has a large, curved, crescent-shaped metal blade that is grayish-silver in color with subtle patches of darker and lighter areas, suggesting an aged or worn surface with some reddish-brown rust spots. The blade is attached to a wooden handle that is cylindrical and horizontally aligned, colored light brown with visible darker wood grain texture lines. The handle shows some wear, giving it a slightly rough appearance. There is a simple joint where the blade meets the handle, and the initials "J B" are inscribed on the metal near this connection. The composition is simple, with the mezzaluna centered and no additional objects or background details present. The artist’s name "Clarence Secor 39" is handwritten in small script in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Food Chopper
